name: Kitchen #17-2 (fresh conversion) -- the DexMate opens the dishwasher, drawers and cabinets

solver.fixtures: each opened through its converted joint (URDF axis, recorded extent)
solver.arm: damped least-squares handle tracking, sampled up to 15 Hz and retimed for joint-rate bounds
solver.resting_arms: source-tree fitted arms at the sides; unused arm/hand stays in its shoulder-relative rest pose
solver.reach_timing: minimum-jerk interpolation, 0.9 rad/s arm and 0.4 rad/s torso animation limits
solver.base: A* over the open floor (Gaussians + meshes, 0.46 m resting-body footprint), trapezoidal speed
solver.clearance: original robot and fixture triangle surfaces checked in base/IK selection; active hand contact excluded
